description: Your People Search tasks, newest first, with status, counts, cost, why each ended search stopped (completion_reason, coverage_limited), and the metadata labels set on people-search. Free. Use it to find a task_id (filter by metadata to find the searches of one campaign), or to see which searches are still queued, running, or paused: a new search is refused while too many are active.

cursor.description: next_cursor from the previous page. Keep the same metadata filter when you page.

metadata.description: Only tasks whose metadata has all of these key/value pairs (exact match, up to 3), example: {"campaign": "q4-outbound"}.

platform.description: Only tasks on this platform: 'x', 'youtube', 'linkedin', or 'tiktok'.

status.description: Only tasks in these statuses, example: ['running', 'paused'].

name: people-search-tasks
title: List People Search Tasks
